proof:
Source. Step 4 of the supplied proof of chart_perimeter: "Λ(p)(a_0, …, a_{n−1}) := det[p, Aa_0, …, Aa_{n−1}] … is multilinear, alternating and continuous in (a_k), and p ↦ Λ(p) is linear". Here the continuity of p ↦ Λ(p) into Λ^n(ℝ^P) is made explicit, as it is needed for the smoothness of the test form.

Proof.
1. (The determinant form.) Let b be the standard orthonormal basis of ℝ^{n+1} (EuclideanSpace.basisFun) and let D := det_b (Module.Basis.det of b.toBasis), the alternating (n+1)-linear form with D(v_0, …, v_n) = det(b.toMatrix v) (Module.Basis.det_apply). The matrix b.toMatrix v has entry (r, c) equal to the r-th coordinate of v_c (Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr). So D(v) is the determinant of the matrix with columns v_0, …, v_n.
2. (D is bounded.) Hadamard's inequality gives |D(v)| ≤ Π_i |v_i|. In Mathlib: for the orientation o := b.toBasis.orientation of ℝ^{n+1} (finrank ℝ^{n+1} = n + 1), Orientation.volumeForm_robust' gives |o.volumeForm v| = |D(v)|, and Orientation.abs_volumeForm_apply_le gives |o.volumeForm v| ≤ Π_i |v_i|. (Any bound |D(v)| ≤ c Π_i |v_i| would do; e.g. the Leibniz formula gives c = (n+1)!.) Hence AlternatingMap.mkContinuous with constant 1 turns D into a continuous alternating map D̄ with D̄(v) = D(v) for all v.
3. (Currying in the first slot.) ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft gives a continuous linear map D̄.curryLeft : ℝ^{n+1} → Λ^n(ℝ^{n+1}) with (D̄.curryLeft p)(w_0, …, w_{n−1}) = D̄(p, w_0, …, w_{n−1}) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft_apply_apply; the tuple is Matrix.vecCons p w = Fin.cons p w).
4. (Pull-back by A.) The map ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM A : Λ^n(ℝ^{n+1}) → Λ^n(ℝ^P), g ↦ g(A·, …, A·), is continuous linear. Put Λ := (compContinuousLinearMapCLM A) ∘ D̄.curryLeft; it is a continuous linear map ℝ^{n+1} → Λ^n(ℝ^P).
5. (Values.) For p ∈ ℝ^{n+1} and a ∈ (ℝ^P)^n: Λ(p)(a) = (D̄.curryLeft p)(Aa_0, …, Aa_{n−1}) = D(Fin.cons p (A∘a)) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply, compContinuousLinearMap_apply, curryLeft_apply_apply), and by step 1 this is the determinant of the matrix with column 0 equal to p and column k+1 equal to Aa_k. After rewriting with Module.Basis.det_apply, this matrix coincides definitionally with Matrix.of fun r c => (Fin.cons p (A∘a) c)_r, which is the asserted formula. ∎

Appendix (verified Lean realization of the numbered proof above; not part of the contract). The declaration below compiles with Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c and simongmt 2b366308 when placed after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission` inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` with the frozen contract's `open` commands (both inside and outside a `noncomputable section`), and `#print axioms` reports only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

```lean
theorem Submission.codim1_lur_det_covector_clm : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)), ∃ Λ : Euclid (n + 1) →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ (p : Euclid (n + 1)) (a : Fin n → Euclid P), Λ p a = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons p (fun k : Fin n => A (a k)) : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r) := by
  intro P n A
  set b := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ with hb
  have : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ (Euclid (n + 1)) = n + 1) := ⟨by simp⟩
  -- Hadamard: |det v| ≤ ∏ ‖v i‖, so the determinant is a continuous alternating map
  have hbound : ∀ v : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1), ‖b.toBasis.det v‖ ≤ 1 * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
    intro v
    rw [one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Orientation.volumeForm_robust' (b.toBasis.orientation) b v]
    exact Orientation.abs_volumeForm_apply_le _ v
  let D : Euclid (n + 1) [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→L[ℝ] ℝ := b.toBasis.det.mkContinuous 1 hbound
  refine ⟨(ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM A).comp D.curryLeft, ?_⟩
  intro p a
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM_apply,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft_apply_apply]
  show b.toBasis.det _ = _
  rw [Module.Basis.det_apply]
  congr 1
```
key_steps: D := det with respect to the standard basis of ℝ^{n+1} is the determinant of the matrix of columns.
Hadamard's inequality |D(v)| ≤ Π|v_i| (Orientation.abs_volumeForm_apply_le) makes D a continuous alternating map via mkContinuous.
Λ := (compContinuousLinearMapCLM A) ∘ D̄.curryLeft is continuous linear.
Λ(p)(a) = D(Fin.cons p (A∘a)) = det[p, Aa_0, …, Aa_{n−1}].
